what: Mistake: did not review the reading or design of a2n5 before drain ran it; it landed a refusal rule that matched common request words to governance files and refused nearly any request mentioning budget, gate or ci, stopping three drains and its own fix three times.
why: A new refusal rule can land without being replayed against real requests; the verifier judges criteria, not whether the rule is sound, and nothing measures how often a new rule would refuse past requests.
